method:
Independent native-ROM and preservation audit for the five forest studies.

Expected concept pixels come from the direct native painters, never the tile
assembler, sprite assembler or asset packer. ROM nibbles, flips, animation
payloads, palettes and descriptor targets are decoded independently. Production
profile zero and every protected surface retain the selected release exactly.
Actual gameplay capture contracts can be compared separately with --runtime.

runtime.method: Compare disclosed fixtures, generated tile-ID/collision/type/spot contracts, maze/progress hashes and action-state transitions; expected RGB art differences are excluded.

mechanical_comparison.method:
Independently compare canonical mechanics, excluding presentation clocks.

    No capture/harness module or mGBA binding is imported here. Global video
    phase, OAM, palette/tile residency and selected visual frame are excluded;
    position, AI state/timers, health, damage, projectiles and RNG are exact.
